dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Don't forget to stretch your muscles and relax in between battles. Otherwise, the fatigue will only build up over time, until your limbs are all sore and stiff.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I know some really good assisted stretches, but I've only done them with Coach Iansan before. She's the only one who can handle my strength...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: ...But I'm sure you can handle it too! How about I help you relax first, and then you help me with my stretching after?
